justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/TypeDescription.java` (lines 6810-6842). `ForLoadedReturnType` is a narrow nested adapter with 1 field (`Method method`) and only 3 behavior methods (`resolve`, `asErasure`, `getAnnotationReader`), each delegating to existing helpers (`Sort.describeOrNull`, `ForLoadedType.of`, `AnnotationReader.Delegator.ForLoadedMethodReturnType`). The companion test file `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/type/TypeDescriptionForLoadedTypeTest.java` exercises it through normal return-type resolution. This looks cohesive and too small/single-purpose to indicate insufficient modularization.
